title: Tanvi Sharma's Denmark Open Run Ends in Quarterfinals Against An Se-young
indian_angle: India's challenge at the Denmark Open concluded with Tanvi Sharma's quarterfinal loss to top seed An Se-young.
summary: Tanvi Sharma put up a strong fight but ultimately fell to world No. 1 An Se-young in the quarterfinals of the Denmark Open, marking the end of India's campaign.

title: Suhas LY Kicks Off Asian Para Games Campaign with a Win
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton star Suhas LY began his Asian Para Games journey with a confident victory.
summary: Paralympic medalist Suhas LY secured a winning start in the badminton event at the Asian Para Games in Aichi Nagoya.

title: Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand in Quarterfinals, Srikanth Exits
indian_angle: India's Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand advanced to the quarterfinals, while Kidambi Srikanth's campaign ended.
summary: The Indian women's doubles pair of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured their spot in the quarterfinals with a straight-game victory, though Kidambi Srikanth was eliminated.

title: Khangurra Assures India a Medal at World Junior Championships
indian_angle: Jagsher Singh Khangurra's advancement guarantees India a medal at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Jagsher Singh Khangurra defeated Yuan-Syue Jhuang to reach the semifinals of the Cairo BWF World Junior Championships, securing at least a bronze medal for India.

title: BAI Announces Formation of New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has established an Athletes Committee to ensure player representation in decision-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has officially announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at giving players a stronger voice in the sport's administration.

title: National Coaching Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: India's junior badminton prospects are training at a national camp in Guwahati in preparation for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing India's young talent.
